$comment: Declares, per pre-commit hook id, whether the hook may write into the repository. pre-commit reports 'files were modified by this hook' for any tree change inside that hook's wall-clock window (pre_commit/commands/run.py _run_single_hook), so a read_only declaration is what lets ops/scripts/attribute_tree_writers.sh exonerate a hook and look for the real writer. Validated by ops/scripts/validate_precommit_hook_contract.py against .pre-commit-config.yaml — every configured hook id must appear here. locality: 'governance' when the hook's entry resolves against the governance tree (it cannot run in a consumer workspace, so run_pr_precommit.sh skips it there); 'any' when it runs in every workspace. Mode and locality are read by run_pr_precommit.sh to build its pass and skip lists, so each hook is declared exactly once.

end-of-file-fixer.note: ensures a trailing newline; may rewrite any passed text file

trailing-whitespace.note: strips trailing whitespace; may rewrite any passed text file. Exception: --markdown-linebreak-ext=md,mdc preserves two-space Markdown hard line breaks, so generator-owned .md/.mdc bytes are not independently canonicalized (tests/ops/test_precommit_markdown_hardbreak.py)

symlinks-check.note: validate_governance_symlinks.sh writes only $HOME/.cursor/plans, outside the repo. Widest window in the hook set, so it absorbs blame for concurrent writers.

adr-identity.note: validate_adr_identity.py — one number per decision; docs/decisions/README.md must match the files

gh-package-deps-preflight.note: validate_gh_package_deps.py — reads package files; optional live registry metadata check

sync-generated-artifacts.note: SKIPped on the make pr path; run_pr_gate.sh heals separately. Prefixes mirror GENERATED_PATH_PREFIXES in ops/scripts/sync_generated_artifacts.py.

ruff.note: runs with --fix; may rewrite any passed Python file

commit-verification-contract.note: validate_commit_verification_contract.py — parses the declaration, greps tracked executables, runs the gate in-process; writes nothing

cursor-skill-projection.note: validate_skill_projection.py — Cursor virtual gateway cardinality; reports only
